title: [Crash] System.ArgumentException: Parameter is not valid.

body_snippet:

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet: This crash occurs in WeifenLuo.WinFormsUI.ThemeVS2013.VS2013SplitterControl.OnPaint — third-party DockPanelSuite NuGet package. The ArgumentException in FillRectangle happens when the splitter rect becomes invalid (e.g., during DPI changes or extreme resize). We cannot fix this in our codebase; it requires an upstream DockPanelSuite fix.
